title: Base Late Fee by Plan: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program 2026-27 Late Payment Fee Schedule
content:
The board-approved 2026-27 late payment fee schedule of the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program sets the base late fee by the enrollment's plan, according to the number of program days per week the plan covers.

| Program days per week of the enrollment's plan | Base late fee |
|---|---|
| two | 8.00 |
| three or four | 10.00 |
| five | the program's late payment fee, 15.00 |

## The plans in each band

| Plan | Program days per week | Base late fee |
|---|---|---|
| Creek Kids Club After-School Care (2 Days) | 2 | 8.00 |
| Creek Kids Club After-School Care (3 Days) | 3 | 10.00 |
| Creek Kids Club Before-School Care (5 Days) | 5 | 15.00 |
| Creek Kids Club After-School Care (5 Days) | 5 | 15.00 |
| Creek Kids Club Before & After-School Care (5 Days) | 5 | 15.00 |
| Creek Kids Club Pre-K Wraparound Care (5 Days) | 5 | 15.00 |

No current plan runs four days per week. A plan of four days would fall in the 10.00 band.

**Which plan.** The plan read is the plan the enrollment holds. After a plan change has taken effect, that is the new plan.
